propositions: The idempotency oracle patches _now_iso only on binding_store, but after RP-02 S2 T2 the absence/tombstone/comment operations (clear_absent, siblings) were moved to binding_lifecycle and resolve their own module-level _now_iso, so the patch no longer reaches them

The integration test still passes because the no-churn contract means the clock is never consulted on a healthy pass, but its blast radius narrowed and would not catch a regression that made clear_absent stamp updated_at unconditionally
The same coverage exists at unit tier via test_binding_lifecycle.py::test_clear_absent_does_not_dirty_an_entry_with_no_absence, so risk is contained
The fix requires patching _now_iso on both binding_store and binding_lifecycle modules to restore the integration oracle's original reach
